title: Space bound from head displacement
statement: Let $R$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $d$ be an initial configuration. If, at every time $u\le t$, every work-tape head lies within distance $r$ of its initial position, then the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited through time $t$ is at most $k(2r+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is a natural number; $\Gamma,P$ are types
$d$ is a configuration of $R$ on an input list
For every time $u\le t$ and every work tape, the head displacement from its initial position has absolute value at most $r$
